info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Payroll Benefits API
info.description: The Update Payroll Benefits API allows organizations to modify existing payroll benefits for their employees. By providing necessary parameters, this API enables HR departments to efficiently adjust benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and other employee perks. This functionality is crucial for ensuring employees receive the most suitable benefits tailored to their circumstance. Typical consumers include HR personnel and payroll administrators who require seamless integration into their human resource management systems.

patch.description: This operation updates the payroll benefits for a specific employee identified by their unique employee ID. Users can modify various aspects of the employee's benefits information to ensure that it is current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the payroll benefits information for the specified employee. Ensure that all required fields are filled with valid data to successfully process the update.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
